description: A single message in a 1:1 conversation, mirrored to AT Protocol as a real org.swappulse.directMessage record. The sender is tracked by authorDid; the recipient by recipientDid so both can read.

main.description: A direct message in a conversation.

conversationId.description: Local id of the Conversation this message belongs to

conversationRef.description: at:// URI of the bridged Conversation record

recipientDid.description: AT Protocol DID of the recipient

authorDid.description: AT Protocol DID of the sender

read.description: True once the recipient has opened the thread containing this message
